question: Kalaripayattu is: (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 3)
options: Embroidery Art of Uttar Pradesh
Folk Dance of West Bengal
Folk Music of Rajasthan
Martial arts and warfare of Kerala
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Martial arts and warfare of Kerala

Explanation:
Kalaripayattu is one of the oldest martial arts in India, originating in Kerala. This warfare art focuses on physical fitness, flexibility, and self-defense. It includes the use of weapons such as swords, shields, spears, and maces. Kalaripayattu has two major styles: the Northern style (Vadakkan) emphasizing weapons, and the Southern style (Thekkan) focusing on hand-to-hand combat. It is not only a combat art but also recognized as an art form and exercise system. It is an integral part of Kerala's cultural heritage and is famous worldwide.

☛ Which state's martial art is Kalaripayattu? → Kerala
☛ What is the Northern style of Kalaripayattu called? → Vadakkan
☛ What is the Southern style of Kalaripayattu called? → Thekkan
☛ What are the main weapons used in Kalaripayattu? → Sword, shield, spear, mace
☛ What is the primary purpose of Kalaripayattu? → Self-defense and physical development

question: Where is the statue depicting Ravana shaking Mount Kailash found? (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 3)
options: in Junagadh Caves
at Ellora Caves
in Ajanta Caves
in the Barabar caves
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is at Ellora Caves

Explanation:
The famous depiction of Ravana shaking Mount Kailash is found in the Ellora Caves, specifically in Cave 14, known as Ravana ki Khai. Located in Aurangabad district, Maharashtra, Ellora is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The scene illustrates an episode from the Shiva Purana where Ravana attempts to lift Mount Kailash, and Lord Shiva subdues him by pressing the mountain with his toe. Ellora Caves are renowned for their Hindu, Jain, and Buddhist rock-cut architecture. This sculpture highlights both Ravana's might and Shiva's supremacy.

question: 'Gatka' is a martial art. It is related to which state? (RPF SI 2018 (24/12/2018) Shift 1)

question: In Tamil Nadu, which day of Pongal is celebrated as Kaanum Pongal? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Third
Second
First
Fourth
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Fourth

Explanation:
Pongal is a four-day harvest festival in Tamil Nadu. The first day is Bogi Pongal (discarding old things), the second day is Surya Pongal (main day, worship of Sun God), the third day is Mattu Pongal (honoring cattle), and the fourth day is Kaanum Pongal (visiting family and friends). Kaanum means 'to see', and on this day people go out, have community feasts, and enjoy games. The festival celebrates the harvest season.

question_hi: तमिलनाडु में, पोंगल का कौन-सा दिन काणुम पोंगल के रूप में मनाया जाता है? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 2)
options_hi: तीसरा
दूसरा
पहला
चौथा
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है चौथा

Explanation:
पोंगल तमिलनाडु का प्रमुख चार दिवसीय त्योहार है। पहला दिन भोगी पोंगल (पुरानी चीजों को जलाना), दूसरा दिन सूर्य पोंगल (मुख्य दिन, सूर्य देव की पूजा), तीसरा दिन मट्टू पोंगल (पशुओं का सम्मान) और चौथा दिन काणुम पोंगल (परिवार और मित्रों से मिलना) मनाया जाता है। काणुम का अर्थ है 'देखना', इस दिन लोग अपने घरों से बाहर निकलकर सामूहिक भोज और खेल-कूद का आयोजन करते हैं। यह त्योहार फसल कटाई के उपलक्ष्य में मनाया जाता है।

question: Which of the following statements is correct about Kati Bihu, one of the three Bihus celebrated especially in the state of Assam? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Kati Bihu is also known as Rangali Bihu.
Kati Bihu marks the beginning of sowing by farmers.
Kati Bihu marks the season of harvesting.
Kati Bihu is observed to pray for standing crops.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kati Bihu is observed to pray for standing crops.

Explanation:
Assam celebrates three Bihus: Bohag Bihu (Rangali Bihu), Kati Bihu (Kongali Bihu), and Magh Bihu (Bhogali Bihu). Kati Bihu is also called Kongali Bihu, meaning 'poor Bihu', as it falls during a period of food scarcity. This festival is observed in October-November when standing crops (like paddy) require care. Farmers light lamps near Tulsi plants and offer prayers for the protection and good yield of crops. Thus, Kati Bihu is a festival of prayer for standing crops, not for sowing or harvesting.

☛ What is another name for Kati Bihu? → Kongali Bihu
☛ What season does Rangali Bihu mark? → Spring and the start of the new year
☛ What is Bhogali Bihu associated with? → Harvest and feasting

question_hi: असम राज्य में विशेष रूप से मनाए जाने वाले तीन बिहुओं में से एक, काटी बिहू के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)

Explanation:
असम में तीन बिहू मनाए जाते हैं: बोहाग बिहू (रंगाली बिहू), काटी बिहू (कोंगाली बिहू), और माघ बिहू (भोगाली बिहू)। काटी बिहू को कोंगाली बिहू भी कहा जाता है, जिसका अर्थ है 'गरीब बिहू', क्योंकि यह खाद्यान्न की कमी के समय पड़ता है। यह त्योहार अक्टूबर-नवंबर में मनाया जाता है जब खड़ी फसलों (जैसे धान) की देखभाल की जाती है। किसान इस दिन तुलसी के पौधे के पास दीप जलाकर और प्रार्थना करके फसलों की रक्षा और अच्छी पैदावार की कामना करते हैं। इसलिए, काटी बिहू खड़ी फसलों के लिए प्रार्थना करने का पर्व है।

question: Mirabai, who was devoted to Lord Krishna and composed innumerable bhajans expressing her intense devotion, became a disciple of which saint from a caste considered ‘untouchable’? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Dadu Dayal
Kabirdas
Ravidas
Surdas
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ravidas

Explanation:
Mirabai, a devout follower of Lord Krishna, chose Sant Ravidas as her spiritual guru. Ravidas belonged to the Chamar caste, which was considered 'untouchable' in the prevailing social hierarchy. He advocated for spiritual equality and rejected caste-based discrimination, emphasizing devotion and self-realization. By becoming his disciple, Mirabai demonstrated that in the path of devotion, caste distinctions are irrelevant. Ravidas's hymns are included in the Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture of Sikhism.

question_hi: मीराबाई, जो भगवान कृष्ण की भक्त थीं और जिन्होंने अपनी गहन भक्ति को व्यक्त करते हुए असंख्य भजनों की रचना की, 'अछूत' मानी जाने वाली जाति से किस संत की शिष्या बनीं? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)

सूरदास
solution_hi:

question: For how many days is the Goa Carnival organised, where elaborate and brilliantly coloured floats, music and dancing form part of the Carnival extravaganza in Goa? (RPF Constable 2024 (05/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Three
Four
Six
Five
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Four

Explanation:

question: The Acheulian cultural tradition is primarily identified with which types of advanced and symmetrical stone tools? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (14/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Blades and borers
Microliths and scrapers
Chisels and adzes
Cleavers and hand-axes
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cleavers and hand-axes

Explanation:
The Acheulian cultural tradition belongs to the Lower Paleolithic period and is primarily identified with hand-axes and cleavers. These tools were bifacially flaked, symmetrical, and technologically advanced. This tradition began around 1.76 million years ago and spread across Africa, Europe, and Asia. Associated with Homo erectus, key Acheulian sites include Saint-Acheul in France, after which the tradition is named. In India, Acheulian tools have been found at sites like Attirampakkam, Hunsgi, and Didwana.

question: The Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus is a prime example of which of the following types of architectural style? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (14/08/2025) Shift 3)

Dravidian
Gothic alone
solution:

Explanation:
The Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (formerly Victoria Terminus), located in Mumbai, is a prime example of the Indo-Saracenic architectural style. This style blends Indian, Islamic, and Gothic elements. Explanation:
छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज टर्मिनस (CSMT), जिसे पहले विक्टोरिया टर्मिनस के नाम से जाना जाता था, का निर्माण 1887 में पूरा हुआ था। यह भवन विक्टोरियन गोथिक शैली में बना है, जो ब्रिटिश वास्तुकला का एक प्रमुख उदाहरण है। इस शैली में ऊंची मीनारें, नुकीले मेहराब और अलंकृत सजावट होती है। CSMT के डिजाइनर ब्रिटिश वास्तुकार फ्रेडरिक विलियम स्टीवंस थे। इस इमारत को यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल का दर्जा प्राप्त है। यह इमारत पारंपरिक भारतीय रूपांकनों के साथ विक्टोरियन गोथिक शैली का अनूठा मिश्रण प्रस्तुत करती है। मुगल और राजपूत शैलियाँ भारतीय मूल की हैं जबकि इंडो-सारासेनिक शैली भी इस इमारत पर लागू नहीं होती।
